why: Both analyses catch the Freshway markdown-app threat (44% of pounds, Eastside down 36%, chainwide next year), decline the café as a Larder Line program, defer the van, cut the add-on programs and flag both denial and undisciplined pursuit. Analysis 1 edges ahead with a denominator closer to the key (usable perishable pounds per route-hour), an explicit donor-concentration target and slightly more careful calibration, while Analysis 2 has the tighter verdict but states one unsupported detail (backpack food as shelf-stable).
